description: Structured, per-feature experiment ledger for Matchday's model research framework. Each entry follows the roadmap's Hypothesis / Baseline / Experiment / Evaluation / Decision template. This is a distillation of the narrative record in docs/PREDICTION_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md plus the checked-in promotion-policy files — it does not replace either; when they disagree, the promotion-policy JSON and the dated prose in PREDICTION_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md are authoritative and this file should be corrected to match.

experiments.hypothesis: Calibrating raw chronological Elo probabilities improves proper scoring over uncalibrated Elo.
experiments.experiment: Calibrated-Elo shadow challenger (model_version nfl-challenger-0.3.0-calibrated-elo-shadow) evaluated on 844 out-of-sample forecasts.
experiments.evaluation: Improved both Brier score and log loss over raw Elo; paired week-block 95% interval for the log-loss improvement excluded zero.
experiments.decision_detail: Approved for a capped, reversible historical pilot: production_weight 0.10, max_shift_points 3.0, allow_pick_flip false.

experiments.hypothesis: A learned model built on nflverse play-by-play features beats chronological Elo.
experiments.experiment: Expanding-window backtest, 2021-2025 seasons, entered shadow deployment 2026-07-29.
experiments.evaluation: Log-loss difference from Elo was statistically indistinguishable from zero; Brier score was worse.
experiments.decision_detail: Remains zero-weight shadow research; the negative result is kept as a permanent part of the model record rather than tuned away.

experiments.hypothesis: Adding a prior-only quarterback signal (most recent observed primary passer's earlier games, never the target game's actual starter) improves the NFL challenger.
experiments.baseline: NFL learned challenger without the QB extension
experiments.experiment: Paired ablation of the prior-only QB feature on the same out-of-sample window.
experiments.evaluation: Paired ablation interval included no improvement.
experiments.decision_detail: Kept only as an uncertainty/provenance receipt, not an accepted production feature. A future timestamped pregame-availability feed is required before the actual-starter version can be tested honestly.

experiments.hypothesis: A residual model layered on advanced features beats calibrated Elo.
experiments.experiment: Same out-of-sample research-gate evaluation used for the calibrated-Elo challenger.

experiments.hypothesis: A licensed, timestamped pregame availability feed will eventually let QB/offensive-line/injury effects be trained and tested.
experiments.baseline: No availability signal in the model
experiments.experiment: Intake contract built to accept only explicitly authorized, source-referenced, pre-kickoff observations (rejects ESPN-origin and retrospective records) into a hash-chained ledger.
experiments.evaluation: Receipt-only so far: no probability adjustment applied, so there is nothing yet to score.
experiments.decision_detail: Blocked on acquiring a licensed availability source and enough frozen pregame history before any effect can be trained.

experiments.feature_family: run-strength model (Pythagorean strength + run differential per game)
experiments.hypothesis: A lean run-strength model beats Elo on MLB.
experiments.baseline: Elo (log loss 0.686457 on the same 2020-2025 Retrosheet out-of-sample set)
experiments.experiment: 9,090 out-of-sample forecasts across 683 sealed date blocks, official Retrosheet 2020-2025 event and game-log archives.
experiments.evaluation: Log loss improved to 0.682207; paired 95% interval [-0.007292, -0.001244]. Other tested historical MLB feature families failed their ablation gates and remain excluded.
experiments.decision_detail: Frozen model attaches a prospective shadow probability to eligible fixtures via the append-only forecast ledger; production_weight is still 0 pending the prospective promotion gate (>=500 games across >=30 date blocks, log-loss + Brier improvement, paired interval upper bound below zero, named manual review).

experiments.hypothesis: A learned model on licensed box-score features beats chronological Elo for NBA/NCAAM.
experiments.experiment: Feature contract and out-of-sample/ablation harness are implemented and ready to run.
experiments.evaluation: Not yet run: no authorized historical box-score export is bundled.
experiments.decision_detail: Zero-weight research path pending a licensed NBA/NCAAM data source per Phase 15's premium-data justification process.

experiments.hypothesis: A learned model on CFBD advanced-metrics features beats chronological Elo for college football.
experiments.experiment: Feature contract, season-week sealing, and per-family ablation harness are implemented.
experiments.evaluation: Not yet run: no authorized multi-season advanced-game export is bundled, so there is no performance claim.
experiments.decision_detail: Zero-weight research path pending a bundled/licensed multi-season export.

experiments.feature_family: xG strength / shot quality / possession-territory / pressure / set-piece / lineup-continuity features
experiments.hypothesis: A regularized three-way residual model on StatsBomb Open Data event features beats a goal-rate Poisson baseline and three-way Elo.
experiments.baseline: Goal-rate Poisson model and three-way Elo
experiments.experiment: Match-date-block ablation harness implemented against official StatsBomb Open Data match/event files.
experiments.evaluation: Not yet run: StatsBomb Open Data coverage is not a live feed and no competition/season corpus is bundled in the repository.

experiments.hypothesis: Tuned three-way Elo built from deeper CC0 domestic-league results improves proper scores over Matchday's default three-way Elo.
experiments.baseline: Default three-way Elo on the identical frozen 2025 season cohort
experiments.experiment: Pinned OpenFootball revision a5dd38b3bcbe3aa2477cf400f569264253d51431 supplied 25,452 validated completed results across EPL, Bundesliga, La Liga, Serie A, and Ligue 1; tune on 2024 and test on 1,751 2025 fixtures across 37 kickoff-week blocks.
experiments.evaluation: Candidate log loss 1.001532 versus 1.004432 and Brier 0.597919 versus 0.599424, but the paired week-block 95% log-loss interval [-0.008859, 0.002669] included no improvement; candidate accuracy was also slightly lower (0.504283 versus 0.507139).
experiments.decision_detail: The deeper CC0 corpus is retained as lawful research input, but the tuned Elo variant failed the frozen promotion gate and remains offline with production_weight 0.

experiments.hypothesis: Matchday's independent NCAAM model, built on opponent-adjusted efficiency and four-factors profiles from CollegeBasketballData box scores, holds information the closing sportsbook consensus has not priced at lock time.
experiments.baseline: Closing no-vig sportsbook consensus on the same fixtures.
experiments.experiment: Pre-registered before the 2026-27 season in ncaam_preregistration.json (terms sealed 2026-08-19, sha256 6a78f62b...). Model artifact must be frozen before 2026-11-01. Primary metric is closing line value; minimum 400 fixtures across 40 game-dates with a 60-minute median lock lead.
experiments.evaluation: Single evaluation after the final graded regular-season fixture. Upheld only if the CLV 95% game-date block bootstrap interval lies entirely above zero.
experiments.notes: Chosen over MLB deliberately: MLB's dominant variable is the starting pitcher, which the market prices and Matchday has no licensed source for, so that gap is an information asymmetry rather than a modelling deficit. The model itself is not yet built; the declaration is registered first on purpose. Implementation started 2026-08-19: ncaam_advanced_metrics.py bridges CBBD team box scores to advanced_metrics.basketball_team_profiles, and fails closed until its field mapping is confirmed against a live response (MAPPING_VERIFIED).
